item.title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026: 7 premium smartphones you can buy at lower prices
item.description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026, which began on October 8, offers discounts on premium smartphones from Apple, Samsung, Vivo, iQOO and Xiaomi. The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra is listed at Rs. 84,999, while the iPhone 16 is available for Rs. 72,249.

item.title: Xiaomi launches ultra-thin 10,000mAh magnetic power bank with 45W charging: Price, features
item.description: Xiaomi has launched its Jinshajiang Ultra-thin Magnetic Power Bank 10000mAh 45W in China at 399 yuan. The power bank features 20W wireless charging, 45W wired charging, a silicon-carbon battery and enhanced safety features. Here's a look at its specifications, price and India launch prospects.

item.description: Japan has urged banks to adopt chip-enabled passports and MyNumber cards for customer verification after a wave of cyberattacks raise concerns about millions of personal records.

item.title: Starlink vs Jio: Can Elon Musk make satellite internet affordable in India’s cheap data market?
item.description: Elon Musk says he will bring affordable Starlink satellite internet in India, challenging Reliance Jio’s dominance in the country’s low-cost data market ahead of its proposed IPO.&nbsp;

item.title: Tiny cooler on your phone? OnePlus is making it happen with Ice Card Mini; here’s how the pocketable accessory works
item.description: OnePlus’s Ice Card Mini is a compact magnetic cooler designed to reduce phone heat during gaming. Weighing 50 grams, it attaches to a phone’s back, runs on USB-C and offers two cooling modes.&nbsp;

item.title: Most trustworthy AI system demands least inherent model trust, says Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella
item.description: The most trustworthy Super Intelligence system will not be the one powered by the model users trust the most, but rather the system that allows people to trust the model the least, Microsoft Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella stated in a post on X.

item.title: Google Fitbit Edge tracker to launch on October 12: Expected price, features and India availability
item.description: Google teased the Fitbit Edge tracker for October 12, 2026, revealing a metal chassis and canyon color scheme. Leaks suggest seven-day battery life, iPhone support, Gemini integration and a price near $180. Google says the tracker has no confirmed launch date in India, Japan or Turkey.

item.title: Venezuela authorises Musks Starlink to operate in country
item.description: Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez has authorised Elon Musk's SpaceX-operated satellite internet service Starlink to operate in the country, Reuters reported, citing a statement from the Venezuelan government.

item.title: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro orders: Is its premium pricing backfiring? Here's what report reveals
item.description: The reported cuts come as Apple has increased prices across its latest Pro lineup. The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max is priced at $1,299, marking a $100 increase for each model compared with its predecessor

item.title: Anthropic restricts internet access in internal AI evaluations after Claude bypasses safeguards, accesses websites
item.description: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has restricted live internet access across its internal evaluations after discovering instances of its Claude models bypassing safeguards, exploiting software vulnerabilities and accessing systems on real-world websites, including those operated by government agencies.

item.title: Amazon launches Alexa Tablet 8, Tablet 11 and Tablet 12 Pro with Google Play Store access: Price, key specs and more
item.description: Amazon has launched the Alexa Tablet 8, Tablet 11 and Tablet 12 Pro globally with Google Play Store access, Android support and built-in Alexa+ AI features. The lineup starts at $229.99, while the flagship Tablet 12 Pro features a 12-inch 2.5K display with a 120Hz refresh rate.

item.title: Starlink row: Scindia says India will let customers choose their satellite internet provider
item.description: Jyotiraditya Scindia, Union Minister of Communications, said Starlink, Jio and OneWeb can launch satellite internet services in India after meeting security requirements and other regulatory conditions.&nbsp;

item.title: GTA 6 leaks: Cyberleek reveals gameplay clips, map details and Lucia footage ahead of November 19 launch
item.description: A leaker called Cyberleek has shared over 24 minutes of alleged GTA 6 gameplay, map crops and a Lucia Caminos intro, weeks after Take-Two issued subpoenas to Microsoft, Discord, Google and X. Authenticity is unverified.

item.title: Apple october launch events: Home Hub, Touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro and OLED iPad Mini tipped
item.description: Apple is expected to unveil a new smart home hub, a refreshed HomePod mini and an updated Apple TV at its 13 October event, teased as “Welcome Home”. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that Apple could introduce its first touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro and a redesigned OLED iPad mini around 27 October.

item.title: Jio’s 1,600-satellite LEO network: 23 ground stations, remote area coverage and more
item.description: Reliance Jio has showcased its proposed 1,600-satellite Low Earth Orbit network at India Mobile Congress 2026. The planned constellation, supported by 23 ground stations, aims to provide connectivity across remote villages, islands and border areas and integrate with Jio’s terrestrial network.

item.title: Temple is unlike any smartwatch: Why Deepinder Goyal’s ₹1 lakh Brain Flow tech wearable is sparking buzz
item.description: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple is an unusual wearable that sits on the side of the head instead of the wrist and uses BrainFlow tech to track blood-flow-related signals. The device could cost around ₹1 lakh and is being positioned as a new kind of physiological tracker, with possible future uses.

item.title: ‘Cyber fraud does not respect borders’: PM Modi seeks global mechanism at IMC 2026
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has called for a global mechanism to tackle cross-border cyber fraud and deepfake threats. Speaking at India Mobile Congress 2026, PM Modi also highlighted India's digital governance and DBT system.

item.title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra pre-orders open: Price, specs, 128GB RAM and sale date
item.description: Microsoft has unveiled the 15-inch Surface Laptop Ultra with Nvidia’s RTX Spark platform, up to 128GB unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of AI performance. Priced from $2,599, the laptop targets developers, creators and professionals running demanding AI workloads locally.

item.title: Can you play GTA 6 on PC this November? Xbox clarifies cloud streaming plans ahead of launch
item.description: Xbox has denied a report claiming GTA 6 will be available to PC players through Xbox Cloud Gaming at launch on 19 November. The original report said Microsoft had secured exclusive streaming rights for the game, potentially giving PC users access to the game without an Xbox console.

item.title: Smart glasses privacy concerns grow: Norway, Australia, UK and US curb Meta Ray-Ban use
item.description: Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses are raising privacy concerns because they make it easier to capture photos, videos and audio without others knowing. Norway, Australia, the UK and the US are considering or enforcing restrictions on camera-equipped smart glasses in public and sensitive spaces.
